impact: 27 empty catch blocks swallow settings persistence and preview-render failures, so UI state silently diverges from stored state.
fix: Replace each empty catch with a debugPrint plus a recorded error field, or propagate a typed failure.

impact: 5 empty catch blocks in staging and cleanup paths hide filesystem failures that later surface as unexplained export errors.
fix: Log the exception with file path context and surface it through the existing RenderIntegrityException channel.

impact: 9 empty catch blocks hide RSS fetch and parse failures, leaving the news feed empty with no diagnostic signal.
fix: Record the failing feed URL and error, then expose a degraded-feed state to the UI.

impact: 6 empty catch blocks hide notification permission and delivery failures, so users silently stop receiving completion alerts.
fix: Log delivery failures and fall back to the in-app toast path when the platform channel throws.

impact: 5 empty catch blocks discard history read/write errors, which can silently lose the user's processed-video ledger.
fix: Log the failure and mark the history store as degraded instead of returning an empty list.

impact: Legacy affinity migration swallows JSON decode errors, dropping all previously accumulated interest weights without notice.
fix: Catch the decode error explicitly, log it, and reset the affinity map deterministically.

impact: 691-line filter builder plus a 2-node call cycle (buildVideoFilter <-> _fallbackVideoFilter) makes filter changes hard to reason about.
fix: Extract per-effect filter segments into separate builders and remove the recursive fallback.

impact: 901-line widget file mixes article rendering, bookmark state, and share actions.
fix: Split header, body renderer, and action bar into separate widgets.

impact: 791-line service combines HTTP transport, RSS parsing, translation, and caching concerns.
fix: Extract transport and parser into separate collaborators.

impact: 610-line service still holds orchestration, staging, probing, and export verification after the command-builder extraction.
fix: Move probe/export/verification steps into the existing lib/core/services/ffmpeg helpers.

impact: processVideo takes 35+ named parameters and co-changes with filter_builders at 0.89, so every filter change touches two large files.
fix: Introduce a single immutable ProcessVideoOptions value object shared by service and builder.

impact: MicrostockAiScreen has zero inbound and outbound graph edges, indicating dead UI surface.
fix: Confirm with the product owner, then delete the screen and its route entry.

impact: 1147-line test file covers multiple concerns, slowing targeted test runs and obscuring failures.
fix: Split into command-builder, filter, and process-lifecycle test files.

impact: README claims zero network transmission and zero external telemetry, but MicrostockNewsService performs HTTP GET requests to external RSS feeds.
fix: Scope the offline claim to video processing and document the news feed network path explicitly.

impact: The Android public-storage path /storage/emulated/0/Movies/Uniquifier is duplicated in 4 files, so a storage-policy change needs 4 edits.
fix: Centralize the path in a single storage constants file and reference it everywhere.

impact: Empty catch on locale decode hides corrupt stored locale values.
fix: Add a debugPrint with the offending value.

impact: 3 empty catch blocks hide SharedPreferences failures on settings write.
fix: Log the failure and keep the in-memory value as the source of truth.

impact: 3 empty catch blocks hide directory-size and free-space probe failures used for the storage check.
fix: Log the probe failure and fall back to a conservative storage estimate.

impact: Indonesian inline comments remain in a codebase that standardized UI and localization on English.
fix: Translate the remaining Indonesian comments to English.

impact: Format gate fails: 7 Dart files are not dart-format clean, so the format check cannot be used as a CI gate.
fix: Run dart format over lib/ and test/ in a whitespace-only commit.
